reason: My team lives in Slack and Trello and it works well enough. Making everyone switch chat and boards at once for a client page is a fight I don't want, and the pitch says nothing about estimates or hours, which is where I actually lose money.
objection: Ripping out Slack and Trello means the whole team has to move together. If one person drags their feet we end up running two tools, and I lose a week of momentum on paid work.
would_change_my_mind: Time tracking against estimates per client, so I could see overruns while a project runs, plus a one-click import from Trello and Slack so the move takes an afternoon, not a month.
